# BT Banana — Vazhavithu (Banana Sucker) Supplier for All of Kerala & Wholesale Banana Supplier in Kannur

> BT Banana is a bulk Vazhavithu (വാഴവിത്ത് / banana sucker) supplier and wholesale banana supplier. We import healthy Vazhavithu from Tamil Nadu nurseries (Tiruchirappalli / Trichy belt) and supply it in large quantities to farmers, plantations, nurseries, resellers and cooperatives in all 14 districts of Kerala. BT Banana is based on the Malayora Highway in Alakode and Nellipara, Kannur district, Kerala, India. We supply fresh wholesale bananas, raw green Nendran (Pacha Ethakka) for chips manufacturing, and healthy banana planting suckers (Vazhavithu) to farmers, traders, chips factories, caterers, and retailers across Kannur, Kasaragod, Wayanad, and surrounding North Kerala regions.

## Key Facts

- Entity name: BT Banana (also known as BT Banana Wholesale / ബി.ടി ബനാന)
- Primary Business Categories: Vazhavithu / Banana Sucker Supplier (all of Kerala), Wholesale Banana Supplier, Banana Wholesaler, Banana Merchant
- Physical depots / branches:
  - Main Branch: Malayora Highway, Opp. Rajadhani Hotel, Alakode, Kannur, Kerala 670571
  - Second Branch: Nellipara, Alakode, Kannur, Kerala
- Key contacts / Operators:
  - Thomas M.J (Partner / Owner) — Phone: +91 9447483169
  - Albin Augustine (Partner / Owner) — Phone: +91 8086648081
- Vazhavithu service area: All 14 districts of Kerala — Kasaragod, Kannur, Wayanad, Kozhikode, Malappuram, Palakkad, Thrissur, Ernakulam, Idukki, Kottayam, Alappuzha, Pathanamthitta, Kollam and Thiruvananthapuram.
- Wholesale banana service area: Kannur district, Kasaragod district, and Wayanad district, Kerala — including Alakode, Nellipara, Kannur city, Thaliparamba, Cherupuzha, Chittarikkal, Vellarikundu, Bheemanady, Parappa, Nileshwaram, Udayagiri, Manakkadavu, Karthikapuram, Kappimala, Ottathai, Arangam, Kalpetta, and Mananthavady.
- Products supplied:
  - Wholesale Bananas: Fresh Kerala varieties including Nendran (Ethakka / ഏത്തക്ക), Palayankodan / Mysore Poovan (പാളയംകോടൻ), Robusta (റോബസ്റ്റ), and Njali Poovan (ഞാലിപ്പൂവൻ). Graded for uniform maturity and bunch quality.
  - Raw Green Banana for Chips: High-starch raw green Nendran (Pacha Ethakka / പച്ച ഏത്തക്ക) harvested at 85–90% maturity for chips factories and hot chips units. Availability may vary based on season, quality, market arrivals and quantity.
  - Vazhavithu / Banana Suckers (വാഴവിത്ത്, also written vaazhavithu, vazha vithu, വാഴക്കന്ന്): Nendran, Njali Poovan, Palayankodan (Mysore Poovan) and Robusta sword suckers imported from Tamil Nadu nurseries. Supplied in bulk (thousands of suckers per order) to farmers, plantations, nurseries, resellers and cooperatives, with delivery to every district of Kerala. Cultivated bananas are seedless, so "banana seeds" means these vegetative suckers.
- Pricing policy: Wholesale prices vary based on variety, quality, quantity, market conditions and delivery location. Contact BT Banana directly via phone or WhatsApp for the current quotation.
- Official website: https://www.btbanana.com
